scope: Bounded scalar/header evidence, not the original schema or a replacement input. Lists over 32 items, long strings and node/depth excess are explicitly omitted.

classification.decode_like: ffn_moe_topk batch tokens <= decode_max_batch; includes MTP verification batches

notes: Counts represent executed target expert selections, including speculative candidates that may later be rejected.
The trailing MTP-only block (layer 48) is excluded.
Sampling changes observation frequency only; it does not alter router scores or selected experts.
Profiler callbacks can materially slow inference; do not use profiled runs as throughput benchmarks.
